title: apify/apify-mcp-server: connect a coding agent to web data tools
friendlyTitle: Apify's MCP server lets agents collect public web data
summary: Apify's MCP server lets coding agents call the company's library of web extractors for sources such as search, maps and public web pages. It was the third-highest new AI-related repository on today's trending list, with about 233 stars today and roughly 11,200 overall.
friendlySummary: This official connector lets a coding agent use Apify's web data tools. It gained about 233 stars today.
whyItMatters: A developer can give an agent a structured way to collect public web data instead of writing a one-off crawler. It is not permission to ignore a site's terms, login walls or rate limits.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to pull public information into an agent workflow. Still follow each website's rules and limits.
